invariants.text: Authority, cognition, and effect records are type-distinct and stored separately.
No model output is authoritative evidence and no model directly authorizes an effect.
Every retained observation names exact source bytes or records why source retention was forbidden.
Capture time is an interval with a declared clock basis, never an unjustified point timestamp.
Stream acceptance, first frame, continuity verification, and semantic detection are distinct states.
Every asynchronous child is owned by an Asupersync region and shutdown drains to a terminal or indeterminate receipt.
Consequential effects use prepare, revalidate, commit, observe, and verify semantics with idempotency.
Credentials are scoped to an adapter instance, never included in traces, model prompts, or evidence bundles.
Proprietary adapters operate only against owner-authorized devices and accounts; credential bypass is out of scope.
Original encoded media is never silently replaced by a transcoded derivative.
Published object graphs are root-last; a visible root cannot reference uncommitted children.
Derived indexes, graphs, embeddings, tracks, and digital-twin renderings are rebuildable from canonical evidence.
A model generation is immutable; mixed-generation embeddings or logits cannot share one score space.
Alert thresholds are versioned policy, not mutable model-side constants.
An alert includes evidence, uncertainty, sensor-health context, and a deterministic decision fingerprint.
Absence of detection cannot become evidence of absence when coverage, continuity, or calibration is degraded.
Privacy masks and excluded zones are applied before remote publication and before any model not authorized for unredacted data.
Face identification, cross-property identity linkage, and biometric enrollment are disabled by default.
The drone is a manually piloted calibration and observation sensor until a separate flight-safety qualification exists.
No v1 effect can deploy a weapon, pursue a person, or physically confront a subject.
Every public readiness claim is derivable from a retained proof bundle and a registered claim class.
Negative evidence, failed experiments, and known blind spots are retained and release-visible.
Local qualification is release authority; hosted CI is supplementary evidence.
A vendor firmware or app generation not in the compatibility registry fails closed or enters an explicit degraded mode.
A redacted or deleted object cannot remain reachable through an undeclared alternate index or cache.
Every durable schema is versioned and old versions remain readable or have a deterministic migration.
Every adaptive policy is bounded by non-adaptive safety invariants and logs its decision basis.
Detection quality is measured at event level under realistic class imbalance, not inferred from frame accuracy.
A false-negative claim includes the defined threat distribution and a confidence bound; absolute never-miss claims are forbidden.
Any operation whose registered cost cannot satisfy its SLO fails design review before implementation.
